final: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS FLOAT) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as bytes_per_ms FROM MediaType mt LEFT JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as cross_media_avg FROM media_stats), filtered AS (SELECT avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms FROM media_stats WHERE bytes_per_ms > (SELECT cross_media_avg FROM cross_avg)) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_prices, AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_of_bytes_per_ms, AVG(bytes_per_ms - (SELECT cross_media_avg FROM cross_avg)) as avg_rate_above_cross_avg FROM filtered    -- Result: (1.985327102803744, 179.4726440695076, 123.81479304935806)
